## Intended use
Decision *support* and triage on telecom support transcripts; proposals are gated by a deterministic policy and human approval above limits. **Not** for automated decisions about customers without that gate, and not validated on real customer data, other languages (beyond English with light Hinglish/Spanglish code-switch handling), or audio.
